notes: Probed the Ultima news route and Tahoe-100M / Arc sources. Tahoe-100M was sequenced on Ultima's UG 100, and Arc's 2025 partnership with 10x and Ultima names the UG 100 for its perturbation screening. None of this is new to the analyst, and none of it gave a read count, Tb figure or cost per read compared with Illumina. The Tahoe bioRxiv full text returned HTTP 429. The Arc and Ultima pages carry no read volumes, and Arc's page does not mention Illumina. Only 1 of 8 projects was covered (Tahoe-100M, plus Arc's partnership and the CZI Billion Cells Project at press-release level). The CZI, Scale Bio 100M Cell Challenge and Broad/Sanger projects were not opened.
how_to_mine: 1) Retry bioRxiv 10.1101/2025.02.20.639398 later (or use the europepmc.org full-text mirror) and read the Methods and Supplement for reads per cell and the number of UG 100 wafers. Total reads is roughly cells x reads per cell. 2) Do the same for the CZI Billion Cells Project (CZI, 10x and Ultima announcement) and the Scale Bio/Nvidia 100M Cell Challenge. 3) Check Arc's GitHub or Hugging Face dataset card for Tahoe-100M. 4) Convert reads to Gb with about 100 bp per read. For example, 100M cells x 30-45K reads per cell is about 3-4.5 trillion reads, or about 300-450 Tb. That would be a large amount of diverted Gb, but it is a guess until the paper's numbers are found, and it should be compared with Illumina's roughly 800M Gb per quarter in HT shipped volume.
